Team You will join the Global Rewards Team, a team at CIP that takes an entrepreneurial and goal-oriented approach to defining and delivering on our business’s overall global rewards strategy. You will play a key role in developing high-quality presentations, communication materials, and structured processes that support the work of the Global Rewards Team. This is a role with a clear focus on creating sharp and impactful PowerPoint materials, helping drive team priorities forward, and contributing to the strategic direction of the team. For the right candidate, this will be a unique opportunity to participate in setting the direction for the rewards and incentives strategy in CIP globally, across a broad range of markets and functions - and at the same time being exposed to rich development opportunities. You will benefit from a fast learning curve within rewards and incentives, in the context of a thriving private equity company that is also one of the fastest growing renewable energy infrastructure firms globally. NB: The role will likely be based in Copenhagen, but we are also open to London-based candidates to join our London office. The work environment at CIP is engaging and fast-paced, and offers an intellectually stimulating atmosphere, amongst diverse colleagues with a global outlook. Therefore, we are looking for a motivated, incisive, and structured professional to join our team. We look for the following in a candidate: Solid financial acumen with ability to translate complex matters into clear messages Experience with rewards / incentives is an advantage but not a requirement. However, you should be interested in embarking on a career within rewards and be willing to take on a steep learning curve Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proficiency in creating high-quality PowerPoint presentations Results-driven with a high execution orientation, and a focus on effective problem solving and clear communication Effective project leadership skills, with experience delivering complex projects in collaboration with multiple stakeholders Self-starter with a structured and disciplined approach to your work, the ability to connect the dots independently, and to thrive in a fast-paced environment The process Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email. As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants. Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors. CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management. CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally. For more information, visit www.cip.com.
